svg.aria-label: Hosh. Keep your head when markets don't. An AI trading copilot for Indian equities and Bitcoin. Above it, Hosh's spirit level drawn in dots, fear on the left and greed on the right, its bubble holding still under a red and green market line that keeps moving.

svg.text: An AI trading copilot for Indian equities and
Bitcoin. Code proposes every trade, AI can only
veto or shrink it, and hard risk limits sit under both.
Private alpha. Paper trading by default.
